sections.title: Player text
sections.body: Daggerheart is narrative fantasy. The GM describes the world, players describe what their characters do, and we roll when the outcome is risky, uncertain, or dramatic.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Daggerheart is narrative fantasy. The GM describes the world, players describe what their characters do, and we roll when the outcome is risky, uncertain, or dramatic.

sections.title: Player bullets
items: Describe what your character tries to do.
If it is risky or uncertain, roll Hope and Fear d12s.
Add the trait that fits your approach.
Tell the GM the total and whether Hope or Fear was higher.
We will learn the rest as it matters.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Teach the minimum Daggerheart rules needed to begin.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Script: Teach only the minimum rules, then move on. Open the GM Rules Drawer for deeper questions, but do not dump the full rulebook before play.
Every rules term should link to the GM Rules Drawer in GM view.
Do not present non-official or stale mechanics as official Daggerheart rules.
Checklist: Duality Dice explained; Hope/Fear explained; Experiences explained; Helping explained; Outcome matrix explained
